prompt: Either a person (name, optional email) or an organization (orgName), never both at once.
notes: We use a `oneOf` block to ensure the byline is either a person (requiring 'name' and optionally 'email') or an organization (requiring 'orgName'). Setting `additionalProperties: false` in both options prevents mixing properties from both structures.

email.description: The email address of the author

name.description: The full name of the author

orgName.description: The name of the publishing organization
